Game Overview

In Connect Letters, the core idea is straightforward: challenge your mind with Connect Letters, a captivating word search where swiping through a letter grid reveals hidden words. As you progress, puzzles intensify, testing your vocabulary and strategic thinking. Perfect for brain training and offering endless addictive fun, it’s a game that you won’t want to stop playing!
